attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Ohio Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) return. Checks for physical presence, economic nexus, or Ohio registration. Ohio CAT nexus: Physical presence (bright-line), Economic nexus ($500K Ohio receipts), or Ohio registration. No tax due threshold: $150K Ohio-sourced gross receipts.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in Ohio (bright-line presence)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code 'OH' streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets Ohio economic nexus threshold ($500K Ohio receipts)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code 'OH' streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Ohio receipts below $150K exclusion threshold; result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts < result.oh_cat_exclusion_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Physical presence but below exclusion threshold - no tax due; Set no CAT due and zero tax
action_details.action_dsl: set result.oh_qualifies_for_no_cat = true; set result.oh_cat_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0;
action_details.action_postfix: true cvb /result.oh_qualifies_for_no_cat xdef 0.0 cvd /result.oh_cat_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus established - CAT calculation required; Mark CAT as due and log bright-line presence
Economic nexus established - CAT calculation required; Mark CAT as due and log economic nexus
No nexus - no filing required; Set no CAT due, zero tax, and refund any payments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.oh_qualifies_for_no_cat = true; set result.oh_cat_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;
action_details.action_postfix: true cvb /result.oh_qualifies_for_no_cat xdef 0.0 cvd /result.oh_cat_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Ohio taxable gross receipts for CAT. Applies situsing rules to determine Ohio-sourced receipts and subtracts excluded receipts. Process: (1) Total gross receipts, (2) Apply situsing rules for OH portion, (3) Subtract excluded receipts, (4) Result is OH taxable gross receipts subject to CAT. Common exclusions: federal government sales, affiliate transactions, interest/dividends, previously taxed receipts.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and above exclusion threshold; result.oh_qualifies_for_no_cat == false
Has receipts excluded from CAT calculation

action_details.action_comment: No nexus or below threshold - no calculation needed
Calculate gross receipts after exclusions; Apply exclusions to Ohio-sourced receipts
action_details.action_dsl: set result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts = the maximum of (result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts - result.oh_cat_excluded_receipts) and (0.0);
action_details.action_postfix: result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts result.oh_cat_excluded_receipts f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts xdef

action_details.action_comment: Use Ohio-sourced gross receipts (no exclusions); Log CAT basis and situsing

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Ohio Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) liability. Applies $150 minimum or 0.26% rate based on gross receipts. Tax structure: Receipts below $150K=No tax, $150K-$999,999=$150 minimum, $1M+=$150 minimum + 0.26% on receipts over $1M. Formula: CAT = $150 + (Taxable Receipts - $1M) × 0.0026. IMPORTANT: CAT has NO credits, purely based on gross receipts.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and above exclusion threshold; result.oh_qualifies_for_no_cat == false
Ohio receipts at or above $1M (subject to percentage tax); result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts >= result.oh_cat_minimum_threshold

action_details.action_comment: No nexus or below exclusion threshold - no CAT
action_details.action_dsl: set result.oh_cat_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.oh_cat_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_comment: Receipts over $1M - calculate percentage tax + minimum; CAT = $150 + (Receipts - $1M) × 0.26%
action_details.action_dsl: set result.oh_cat_tax = (result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts - result.oh_cat_minimum_threshold) * result.oh_cat_rate + result.oh_cat_minimum_tax; set apportionment.state_tax = result.oh_cat_tax; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: result.oh_taxable_gross_receipts result.oh_cat_minimum_threshold f- result.oh_cat_rate fmul result.oh_cat_minimum_tax f+ cvd /result.oh_cat_tax xdef result.oh_cat_tax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_comment: Receipts between $150K and $1M - minimum tax only
action_details.action_dsl: set result.oh_cat_tax = result.oh_cat_minimum_tax; set apportionment.state_tax = result.oh_cat_tax; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: result.oh_cat_minimum_tax cvd /result.oh_cat_tax xdef result.oh_cat_tax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.oh_cat_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.oh_cat_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
